description: Establish and confirm the in-sandbox baseline before adding anything. Verify Python tooling is healthy so later features build on a known-green state. This is fast and non-destructive.
steps: From repo root /projects/sandbox/happyBOT, run `python3 --version` and record it.
Run `python3 -m py_compile tools/analyze_report.py tools/test_analyze_report.py` and confirm no errors.

Run the existing analyzer test suite: `python3 -m unittest -v tools.test_analyze_report` (or `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py'`) from repo root; confirm all 16 tests pass. Record the exact command that works.

Confirm the analyzer's public API by reading tools/analyze_report.py: note that analyze_file(path, json_dir=None, write_json=True) returns a summary dict with summary['metrics'] and summary['diagnosis'], and writes <basename>.summary.json. Confirm metric keys available (total_net_profit, profit_factor, relative_drawdown_pct, maximal_drawdown_pct, total_trades, win_rate_pct, recovery_factor) against reports/samples/sample_report.summary.json.

Run `grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' GaganEA.mq5 tools/analyze_report.py automation/run_backtest_loop.ps1 automation/backtest_template.ini` to record the CURRENT ASCII state as a baseline (README.md/ITERATION_LOG.md already contain em dashes and are pre-existing; do not modify them for ASCII in this feature).
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m py_compile succeeds on both existing tools .py files.
The existing analyzer test suite runs and all 16 tests pass; the working command is recorded in findings.
The analyzer summary-dict API and metric key names are confirmed and recorded in findings for FEAT-002 to reuse.
The baseline ASCII state of the code/script files (excluding pre-existing markdown) is recorded.
verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' from repo root shows OK with 16 tests.

findings.py_compile: python3 -m py_compile tools/analyze_report.py tools/test_analyze_report.py -> exit 0, no errors.
findings.test_command: WORKING: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py'` from repo root -> Ran 16 tests, OK. NOTE: `python3 -m unittest tools.test_analyze_report` and `python3 -m unittest -v tools.test_analyze_report` FAIL with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'analyze_report', because tools/test_analyze_report.py does a bare `import analyze_report` (line 23) which requires tools/ on sys.path. Discover adds the start dir (tools/) to sys.path so it resolves; the dotted-module form does not. FEAT-002 tuner tests should either use discover, or run from inside tools/, or the test should insert its dir into sys.path. All 16 existing tests pass under the discover form.

analyzer_api.entrypoint: analyze_file(path, json_dir=None, write_json=True) in tools/analyze_report.py (line 764). Returns the summary dict from summarize(path, metrics, trade_table, flags) (line 666). When write_json=True it writes <basename>.summary.json next to the report (or into json_dir if given). Raises on I/O errors.
analyzer_api.summary_dict_shape: top-level keys: report, report_path, metrics (dict), trade_table (dict: count, profit_column_found, aggregate, rows_truncated, rows_kept), diagnosis (dict: verdict, flags[]).
analyzer_api.reuse_guidance: FEAT-002 must reuse analyze_file / summarize or read the .summary.json; do NOT reimplement MT5 report parsing.

findings.ascii_baseline: grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' GaganEA.mq5 tools/analyze_report.py automation/run_backtest_loop.ps1 automation/backtest_template.ini found 3 PRE-EXISTING non-ASCII occurrences (all out of scope, not introduced by this feature): GaganEA.mq5:1426 (em dash in a comment '// Background - taller...'), GaganEA.mq5:1429 (em dash in a comment '// Title row - orange...'), tools/analyze_report.py:204 (currency symbols in regex re.sub(r"[$EUR GBP JPY %]", "", s) - used intentionally to strip currency chars). automation/run_backtest_loop.ps1 and automation/backtest_template.ini are clean ASCII. New/edited code files in later features must stay pure ASCII.
findings.verification_note: No source files created or modified in this verification-only feature. Only the task-state feature file was updated. In-sandbox verification only: NO MQL5 compiler / MT5 / PowerShell available, so EA compile, Strategy Tester runs, and the PowerShell loop remain UNVERIFIABLE here.
